title: The stickers, i
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Monday. A sample arrives: a sheet of stick-figure stickers, the helicopter figure, thirty of him. A licensing sample for a thing the strip never agreed to. The pup gets to it first.

panels.composition: The garage. An envelope torn open on the floor — BARNABY II has already been at it. A sheet of stickers half out.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a torn-open envelope on a garage floor with a glossy sticker sheet half pulled out by a small three-legged dog

panels.composition: The sheet: thirty stick figures with four-line rotors on their heads, glossy, die-cut. The 2006 stick figure, mass-produced. Wood's hand picking it up.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a glossy die-cut sticker sheet of thirty identical crude stick figures with helicopter rotors on their heads, a man's hand lifting it
image.notes: The ROLFCOPTR figure (dw_2006-11). Thirty of him. Glossy.

panels.composition: WOOD reading the cover letter. The dog with one sticker already on his nose.
props: a sticker on the dog's nose

balloons.text: '…enclosed sample of the licensed —' Who licensed it. I didn't license it.
(reading) '…in the public domain by common usage.'

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man reading a letter with a rising expression while a small dog beside him has a sticker stuck to its nose

panels.composition: Wood looking at the dog with the sticker on his nose. The dog cross-eyed at it. Twenty-nine left on the sheet.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man looking at a small three-legged dog that is going cross-eyed at a sticker stuck to its own nose, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: 'In the public domain by common usage.' One sticker on the nose.
